media_and_arrays.claim: All selected image pixels, video frames, and non-pickle arrays were decoded/inspected programmatically; this is not an assertion of manual visual review.

limits: Project result and recorded source scopes, not all unrelated files on the server.
Runtime environment trees, model weights, repository VCS objects and unrelated projects not exhaustively re-audited; result-embedded source copies were read.
Identical files are full-byte hashed individually and content analysis is reused by SHA256.
Media decoding validates content/readability, not physical success; native scores and retained traces are authoritative.
Nov2 supplementary packages do not contain execution videos; unavailable originals cannot be reviewed.
Present files cannot reconstruct unrecorded historical actions or prove deleted files never existed.
